question.problem:
The recursive formula for the Fibonacci numbers is 

$$
{a}_{n+2}={a}_{n+1}+{a}_{n},\,{a}_{1}={a}_{2}=1,\,n\ge 1.
$$

What is the eighth number in the sequence?
question.worked_solution:
Substituting $n=1$ into the recursive formula gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{1+2} & ={a}_{1+1}+{a}_{1} \\ {a}_{3} & ={a}_{2}+{a}_{1} \\ {a}_{3} & =1+1 \\ {a}_{3} & =2\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting $n=2$ into the recursive formula gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{2+2} & ={a}_{2+1}+{a}_{2} \\ {a}_{4} & ={a}_{3}+{a}_{2} \\ {a}_{4} & =2+1 \\ {a}_{4} & =3\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting $n=3$ into the recursive formula gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{3+2} & ={a}_{3+1}+{a}_{3} \\ {a}_{5} & ={a}_{4}+{a}_{3} \\ {a}_{5} & =3+2 \\ {a}_{5} & =5\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting $n=4$ into the recursive formula gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{4+2} & ={a}_{4+1}+{a}_{4} \\ {a}_{6} & ={a}_{5}+{a}_{4} \\ {a}_{6} & =5+3 \\ {a}_{6} & =8\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting $n=5$ into the recursive formula gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{5+2} & ={a}_{5+1}+{a}_{5} \\ {a}_{7} & ={a}_{6}+{a}_{5} \\ {a}_{7} & =8+5 \\ {a}_{7} & =13\end{aligned}
$$

Substituting $n=6$ into the recursive formula gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{6+2} & ={a}_{6+1}+{a}_{6} \\ {a}_{8} & ={a}_{7}+{a}_{6} \\ {a}_{8} & =13+8 \\ {a}_{8} & =21\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $21$ is the eighth number in the sequence.
